title: Pixel Vault
tagline: Navigate a shifting dungeon collecting gems before the floor collapses beneath you.
coreMechanic: Timed platforming with crumbling tiles. Each floor section disappears after you step on it.
uniqueTwist: The dungeon layout procedurally rearranges every 30 seconds.
visualStyle: Dark pixel art with glowing gem highlights and particle dust effects.

title: Drift Neon
tagline: Slide a neon car through synthwave traffic in an endless highway.
coreMechanic: Tap or swipe to lane-change while dodging traffic at increasing speeds.
uniqueTwist: Collecting neon orbs charges a time-slow ability.
visualStyle: Synthwave neon gradients on dark asphalt, glowing trail effects.

title: Stack Empire
tagline: Build the tallest tower by perfectly timing each dropping block.
coreMechanic: Blocks slide horizontally; tap to drop. Overhanging parts are trimmed.
uniqueTwist: Every 10 floors unlocks a new block type with special properties.
visualStyle: Clean geometric blocks with gradient fills and subtle shadows.

title: Hex Collapse
tagline: Match hexagonal tiles before the board fills up and overflows.
coreMechanic: Place hex tiles to form color groups of 3+. Groups collapse and score points.
uniqueTwist: The board slowly rotates, changing which tiles are adjacent.
visualStyle: Flat pastel hexagons with smooth collapse animations.

title: Orbit Guard
tagline: Defend your planet by rotating a shield around it to deflect asteroids.
coreMechanic: Drag to rotate a shield arc around your planet. Asteroids bounce off the shield.
uniqueTwist: Deflected asteroids can chain-hit other asteroids for combos.
visualStyle: Deep space background with glowing shield and particle explosions.

title: Turret Tycoon
tagline: Place and upgrade turrets to survive increasingly wild enemy waves.
coreMechanic: Earn gold from kills, spend on turret placement and upgrades along a fixed path.
uniqueTwist: Turrets can be combined into hybrid types with merged abilities.
visualStyle: Cartoonish top-down military with bright explosions.

title: Card Clash
tagline: Play cards from your hand to outsmart an AI opponent in quick rounds.
coreMechanic: Each card has attack/defense values. Higher total wins the round.
uniqueTwist: Cards have elemental affinities that create rock-paper-scissors matchups.
visualStyle: Fantasy card art with gold trim, satisfying flip animations.

title: Beat Bounce
tagline: Bounce a ball in rhythm to the beat to score points.
coreMechanic: Tap in time with the music beat. Perfect timing gives a higher bounce.
uniqueTwist: The ball's trajectory creates visual art patterns over time.
visualStyle: Neon wireframe with reactive background that pulses to the beat.

title: Gold Mine Idle
tagline: Dig deeper, hire miners, and automate your way to riches.
coreMechanic: Click to mine, earn gold to buy auto-miners that dig while idle.
uniqueTwist: Deeper layers have rare gems that unlock prestige multipliers.
visualStyle: Cozy pixel underground with warm lamp lighting.

title: Shadow Runner
tagline: Sprint through a shadow world where light reveals the path ahead.
coreMechanic: Move through a dark maze; your character emits light that reveals nearby walls.
uniqueTwist: Enemies are only visible in darkness — light blinds them but reveals traps.
visualStyle: High contrast black and white with a single accent color.

title: Void Racer
tagline: Race through an abstract 3D tunnel dodging geometric obstacles.
coreMechanic: Tilt to steer left/right through an endless tunnel. Speed increases over time.
uniqueTwist: Collecting prisms warps the tunnel geometry in beautiful ways.
visualStyle: Wireframe neon geometry with depth fog and bloom effects.

title: Sky Hopper
tagline: Hop between floating islands in a low-poly sky world.
coreMechanic: Jump between procedurally placed floating platforms. Miss and you fall.
uniqueTwist: A wind mechanic pushes you mid-air, requiring trajectory compensation.
visualStyle: Low-poly pastel islands with fluffy cloud particles.

title: Cube Shift
tagline: Rotate a 3D puzzle cube to align colored faces.
coreMechanic: Swipe to rotate cube layers. Match all faces of each side to one color.
uniqueTwist: Timer pressure with bonus time for speed-solving sections.
visualStyle: Glossy colored cubes with satisfying snap animations.

title: Cloud Patrol
tagline: Fly a paper airplane through ring checkpoints in the sky.
coreMechanic: Tilt controls to navigate a paper plane through floating ring gates.
uniqueTwist: Thermals boost altitude; rain zones pull you down.
visualStyle: Watercolor sky with paper-craft airplane and clouds.

title: Bunker Blitz
tagline: Survive waves of enemies in a first-person bunker defense.
coreMechanic: Aim and shoot approaching enemies from a fixed bunker position.
uniqueTwist: Between waves, spend scrap to repair walls and add weapon attachments.
visualStyle: Gritty low-poly military with muzzle flash and screen shake.

title: Marble Maze
tagline: Tilt the world to guide a marble through a 3D labyrinth.
coreMechanic: Arrow keys tilt the maze platform. Gravity rolls the marble to the exit.
uniqueTwist: Collecting stars unlocks shortcuts that physically reshape the maze.
visualStyle: Polished marble on wood texture with soft ambient lighting.

title: Bounce Blitz
tagline: Launch balls at moving targets in rapid-fire arcade action.
coreMechanic: Aim and shoot bouncing balls at targets. Balls ricochet off walls.
uniqueTwist: Multi-ball power-ups split your shot into a satisfying spread.
visualStyle: Bright primary colors with comic-style impact effects.

title: Warp Field
tagline: Navigate a ship through space where gravity wells bend your path.
coreMechanic: Thrust forward while gravity wells pull and slingshot your ship.
uniqueTwist: You can drop temporary gravity beacons to create your own slingshots.
visualStyle: Dark starfield with glowing gravity distortion rings.

title: Lava Leap
tagline: Jump between sinking stones as lava rises beneath you.
coreMechanic: Platforms slowly sink into lava when you stand on them. Keep jumping upward.
uniqueTwist: Collecting fire gems lets you briefly walk on lava.
visualStyle: Volcanic cavern with orange-red glow and heat shimmer effects.

title: Galactic Drift
tagline: Race a spaceship through asteroid fields in third person.
coreMechanic: Dodge asteroids and collect fuel to keep flying. Speed increases over time.
uniqueTwist: A magnetic tractor beam lets you grab small asteroids as shields.
visualStyle: Deep space with volumetric nebula colors and metallic asteroids.
